root.name: Mikenas Defense: Pozarek Gambit
root.moves: 1. d4 Nc6 2. c4 e5 3. dxe5 Nxe5 4. Nc3 Nxc4

overview: After 1.d4 Nc6 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 Nxe5 4.Nc3 Nxc4, Black grabs the c-pawn and White tries to catch the knight or gain time with e4 and Qd4 ideas. It is a rare gambit and Black's extra pawn is hard to take back. Strong players seldom enter it.

white_ideas.idea: Develop quickly with e4 and Bxc4 ideas
Hit the c4 knight with Qa4 or Qd4
Use open lines on the e- and d-files

black_ideas.idea: Keep the c4 pawn and retreat the knight safely

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White a pawn down

character.notes: White plays for lead in development and tactics.

gambit.notes: White gives a pawn, usually the c-pawn, and Black can keep it.

soundness.notes: Probably dubious as Black stays a clean pawn up.

approach.notes: Very rare, mostly played for surprise.

level.notes: Needs tactical knowledge; not a beginner line.

character.reason: White sacrifices a pawn for open lines and quick tactics.

gambit.reason: White is a pawn down at the root and Black can keep it.

soundness.reason: The compensation for the c-pawn looks inadequate.

structure.reason: The centre opens straight away with the pawn trades on e5.

approach.reason: Strong players seldom play either side of this.

level.reason: A dubious gambit cannot be Beginner and the plans are easy to read.

plans.reason: White's whole case is faster development for the pawn.
